description: This PHP file defines the ImportView class for the SuiteCRM import module. It handles import view rendering, language loading, menu generation, and error display within the import process.

classes.name: ImportView
classes.description: A view class for handling the import process in SuiteCRM, extending SugarView, manages import steps, language support, and error display.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ImportView, manages current step based on request parameters, and sets import module.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Loads language-specific JavaScript cache if not already loaded, prepares the client-side language resources.

methods.name: getMenu
methods.description: Generates the menu for the import module, adjusting language strings accordingly.

methods.name: _getModuleTab
methods.description: Determines the appropriate module tab for the import, defaulting to 'Home' if not found.

methods.name: sendJsonOutput
methods.description: Outputs data (HTML, scripts, titles) as JSON, optionally encoding for security.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Prepares the title parameters for the module, including current import step.

methods.name: getInstruction
methods.description: Fetches and formats the import instruction string for display.

methods.name: _showImportError
methods.description: Displays an error message within a Smarty template during the import process.
